description: One school's policy as the Playlist Builds list shows it, read and nothing else. No model is called and nothing is saved. Give unitid. The answer gives policy_in_use, the policy an open or a run would use (policy_id, source: pages, inferred or survey, source_by, trust_state, status, built_by, created_at, capture_year), or null where none is in use; and missing_content, each kind in its own field: no_policy_pages, true where none of the school's captured pages carries institution-wide rules, and pages_policy_lacks, the pages the open would read now that are not among the pages the policy in use was saved with (capture_file, source_url); and walk, the walk an operator's Surf asked Gather for, as its file holds it (standing asked, walking, filed or not_filed, with the file's own words), or null where none was asked. For the full account of a school's pages and policies use playlist_policy_diagnose. Read-only.
